record.paper_title: Positive and free boundary solutions to singular nonlinear elliptic problems with absorption: an overview and open problems
record.original_question: Can multiplicity phenomena analogous to those discussed in the paper be established for diffusion operators beyond the Laplacian and p-Laplacian, including general linear second-order operators, Hamilton–Jacobi type operators, Monge–Ampère operators, bi-Laplacians, nonlinear systems, and Schrödinger systems?

evidence.quote: Multiplicity for different diffusion operators (not only a general linear second order operator or the p-Laplacian operator, but other nonlinear operators of Hamilton-Jacobi type, Monge-Amp`ere, bi-Laplacian, nonlinear systems, Schroedinger systems, etc.)

artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as a general open research direction concerning extension of multiplicity results for singular elliptic problems beyond the Laplacian and p-Laplacian. No comprehensive resolution covering linear second-order, Hamilton–Jacobi, Monge–Ampère, bi-Laplacian, nonlinear and Schrödinger system settings appears in the literature; partial results exist in individual cases but a unified answer remains open.

status_evidence.title: Positive and free boundary solutions to singular nonlinear elliptic problems with absorption
status_evidence.snippet: Listed as an open problem regarding multiplicity for diffusion operators beyond the Laplacian and p-Laplacian.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is stated as open in the survey listing of open problems.
